claim: Toxoplasma gondii is an obligate intracellular parasite capable of infecting nearly all warm-blooded animals and frequently causing human infections.
source: Toxoplasma gondii is an obligate intracellular parasite, capable of infecting nearly all warm-blooded animals and frequently causing human infections (Dubey, 2010).
evidence: Supported by citation to Dubey, 2010

claim: The ingestion of tissue cysts in undercooked meat or shed oocysts by infected cats are the major transmission routes of T. gondii.
